title: Gemini assists a proof of stability for three-dimensional passive quantum memory
summary: Patrick Hayden reports a three-dimensional welded-code construction and stability results in separate thermal and zero-temperature perturbative regimes.

evidence.tested: The source reports Lean 4 checks of standalone formulations of core claims, including the main zero-temperature result and a positive-temperature result in the companion paper.
evidence.unknown: The Lean development covers selected formulations in specified regimes. It does not check every manuscript statement or demonstrate a physical device.
evidence.ai_role: The author specified the problem and proof strategy and credits Gemini 4 Argon with most detailed reasoning and proof construction.
